violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Plastic food tray lids and boxes on top of the cook line were not inverted.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. The front hand sink had dirty trays placed over it blocking it. This must be kept accessible for hand washing.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean racks that hold taco shells. -Clean shelf under microwave.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. -Clean racks used for storing clean dishes.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors need more cleaning in kitchen, floor drains and walk in cooler.
